notes: Simulation: under the wall of UI code this is a seed shop with stock counts, prices, rarities and a restock timer, which is the storefront of a farming/incremental simulator rather than a genre of its own. Most of the prompt is Luau and GUI work with no layout job, but stage B answers yes twice and loudly — the author's first requirement is that the player MUST physically walk around and approach the stall for the prompt to fire, so this is neither a P5 nor a SET. Took space-bounded from the catalogue instead of the genre's world-open default because the author settled scale at a small baseplate just big enough to spawn and walk to the stall, which is one bounded single-level space, not a shared persistent world. Preset is none rather than Incremental Simulator: swapping that shape and dropping both gate-progression and path-circulation leaves nothing recognisable, since no upgrade walls or production area exist yet in this vertical slice. The stall is social-hub bent to a classic stud-textured seed stall; the requested spawn point has no option ID in the loaded files and should be placed facing the stall.
